cause_quote: The added condition `|| (params.recorder?.captureModelPromptProjection && !firstText?.startsWith(INTER_SESSION_PROMPT_PREFIX_BASE))` allowed an ordinary foreground turn to persist a projection even when its text matched the stored prompt, triggering a transcript generation rotation.
user_saw: Workshop could fail to save and announce a learned skill when another turn ran in the same session during its background review.
summary: The fix persists the first prompt snapshot without rotating the transcript generation when replay content and the rest of the event are unchanged.
reasoning: The parent already had a Gateway test that expected Workshop learning to finish after a later foreground turn, and its prompt capture code skipped identical text on the first capture. PR #169237 made that capture write to SQLite, where the existing rewrite rule rotated the generation and invalidated the earlier completed turn’s anchor.
